notes.title: v1.2.1d
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug in the AI that would cause the AI to skip it's turn and fail to score full lilypads
[*] Fixed a graphical bug causing frogs returning to your hand to not move smoothly in some cases
[*] Added hot-keys for in game play
[*] Minor UI enhancements
[*] Portal games show a status of "Updating" until the first server update
[*] Fixed a bug that unselected your frog when you dragged the board
[*] Fixed a bug causing it to not save properly after you undo a move
[/list]
